name: Server Graveyard
description: Racks the length of a street, tipped into the mud when the Quiet began. Something down there still has power, and it has been singing the same four seconds for a hundred and sixty years.

variants.description: Racks the length of a street, and one empty cradle at the end of them with its restraints cut. The singing has stopped, because the thing that was singing is walking with you.
Racks the length of a street, and at the end of them a cradle with something broken in it. The Quiet is quieter than it was.
